# Kahawa West Directory (KWEST)
> Official hyper-local digital business directory, domestic services index, and emergency helpline hub for Kahawa West, Roysambu Constituency, Nairobi County, Kenya.

## Core Resources
- [Directory Homepage](https://www.kahawawestdirectory.co.ke/): Main portal to search 55+ verified local businesses, fundis, and clinics
- [Community Spotlight Stories](https://www.kahawawestdirectory.co.ke/#community-hub-section): Investigative local journalism, school fee guides, and estate safety reports
- [List a Business](https://www.kahawawestdirectory.co.ke/?view=list-business): Free registration portal for Kahawa West shop owners and service providers
- [XML Sitemap](https://www.kahawawestdirectory.co.ke/sitemap.xml): Machine-readable index of all business profiles and community updates
- [Robots Directives](https://www.kahawawestdirectory.co.ke/robots.txt): Crawler access rules and sitemap reference

## Estate Zones
- [Congo Commercial Hub](https://www.kahawawestdirectory.co.ke/?zone=Congo): Central retail corridor, market stalls, and cyber services
- [Roundabout Center](https://www.kahawawestdirectory.co.ke/?zone=Roundabout): Commuter interchange, chemist hub, and matatu stages
- [Jacaranda Estate](https://www.kahawawestdirectory.co.ke/?zone=Jacaranda%20Estate): Quiet residential zone, academies, and daycare centers
- [Northern Bypass](https://www.kahawawestdirectory.co.ke/?zone=Northern%20Bypass): Highway transit strip, auto garages, and logistics
- [Kware and Quarry](https://www.kahawawestdirectory.co.ke/?zone=Kware%20%2F%20Quarry): Domestic artisans, fundis, welders, and hardware stores
- [Bima Road](https://www.kahawawestdirectory.co.ke/?zone=Bima%20Road): Healthcare clinics, pharmacies, and salons
- [Kamae](https://www.kahawawestdirectory.co.ke/?zone=Kamae): Mechanics, car wash centers, and domestic workshops

## Directory Categories
- [Food and Dining](https://www.kahawawestdirectory.co.ke/?category=food-fresh): Local eateries, nyama choma grills, bakeries, and milk bars
- [Healthcare and Chemists](https://www.kahawawestdirectory.co.ke/?category=health-wellness): 24/7 pharmacies, medical centers, and clinics
- [Fundis and Domestic Specialists](https://www.kahawawestdirectory.co.ke/?category=mama-fua-domestic): Plumbers, electricians, carpenters, and mama fua
- [Housing and Rentals](https://www.kahawawestdirectory.co.ke/?category=home-rentals): Bedsitters, 1-bedroom apartments, and rent collection agents
- [Automotive and Mechanics](https://www.kahawawestdirectory.co.ke/?category=automotive-mechanics): Garages, tyre clinics, and spare parts

## Emergency Hotlines
- [National Emergency](tel:999): Police, Fire, and Ambulance (999 or 112)
- [Nairobi Fire and Rescue](tel:+254202222181): +254 20 222 2181
- [Kenya Power Dispatch](tel:97771): 97771 or +254 703 070 707
- [Kahawa West Community Helpline](tel:+254764405842): +254 764 405 842

## Optional
- [About KWEST](https://www.kahawawestdirectory.co.ke/?view=about): Mission statement, community guidelines, and verified data standards
- [Ad Space and Sponsorship](https://www.kahawawestdirectory.co.ke/?view=advertising): Banner placement and sponsored listings for local merchants
